content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler Peaches Stage 1 is a smooth puree made from ripe peaches, specially formulated for infants aged 6–12 months. The puree has a uniform texture, contains no added sugar, salt, or preservatives, making it a safe first fruit option.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Peaches belong to the Rosaceae family and are close relatives of plums, apricots, and cherries.
In Stage 1 puree only the flesh is used; the pit is completely removed to eliminate choking hazards.
Peaches are rich in vitamin C, which supports immunity and aids iron absorption.
The fiber content helps develop a healthy gut microbiome in babies.
Fruit purees are often introduced after vegetable purees to familiarize the child with a mildly sweet taste.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C is a powerful antioxidant that supports the immune system and tissue development.

items.title: Contains beta‑carotene
items.content: Beta‑carotene converts to vitamin A, essential for vision and cell growth.

items.title: Low allergen potential
items.content: Peach puree rarely triggers allergic reactions, though any new food should be introduced gradually.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: A modest amount of dietary fiber promotes soft stools and helps prevent constipation.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Peaches are about 85 % water, contributing to proper hydration for infants.

items.title: Allergy
items.content: Although uncommon, some infants may be allergic to peaches. Monitor for any reaction when first introduced.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Peaches are naturally sweet; do not add extra sugar or combine with other sweet foods.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: The mild acidity may cause slight stomach irritation in sensitive babies; choose fully ripe fruit.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the puree chilled or warmed to room temperature. It can be blended with other Stage 1 foods (e.g., carrot puree) for flavor variety.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the unopened package refrigerated and use within 48 hours. After opening, transfer to an airtight container and consume within 24 hours. Discard if any off‑odor or discoloration appears.
